upload.title: Uploading files
upload.single: For a single HTML file: drag and drop an .html or .htm file onto the dropzone, then click Upload.
upload.zip: For multi-file presentations (slides with CSS, JS, images, video): package everything into a .zip file and upload it. The server extracts the ZIP automatically.
upload.limit: Maximum file size: 50 MB. Daily limit: 5 uploads per IP (resets at UTC midnight).

zip.title: Organizing a ZIP bundle
zip.entry: The ZIP must contain an index.html (or main.html) at the top level. This is the entry point for the presentation.
zip.structure: Place assets in subfolders and reference them with relative paths. Example structure:
zip.relative: Use relative paths in your HTML (e.g. assets/runtime.js, not /assets/runtime.js). The server serves all files from the bundle root.
zip.nesting: If all files are inside a single top-level folder (e.g. my-deck/), the server strips that prefix automatically — no need to flatten.
zip.video: Video files support HTTP range requests, so seeking works in the browser.

tokens.title: Setting access tokens
tokens.what: Access tokens are passwords that protect your uploaded content. Viewers must enter a valid token to see the page.
tokens.how: After selecting files, expand the Access Protection panel. Click Add token for each file, enter a password, and optionally set a max visit count.
tokens.max: Set max visits to -1 for unlimited access, or a positive number to limit how many times the token can be used.
tokens.manage: You can manage tokens later from the upload history sidebar — click the lock icon on any item.
tokens.share: Share the view URL along with the token password with your audience. Without the token, the content is inaccessible.

tokens.title: Access Protection (optional)
tokens.description: Set passwords/tokens to protect your uploads. Each token can have a visit limit.
tokens.gatePrompt: This content is protected. Enter the access token to view.
